video.description:
Learn to explain how to read a crash and find the line that caused it: Crash Report, Stack Trace & dSYM, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Crash Report - A file that records what the app and the device were doing at the moment the app stopped.
Stack Trace - A list of the function calls that were active when an error happened, from newest to oldest.
dSYM - A debug symbols file that turns raw addresses in a report back into function names.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Explain Crash Report, Stack Trace & dSYM in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Crash Report, Stack Trace, dSYM 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Crash Report - A file that records what the app and the device were doing at the moment the app stopped.
한국어: Crash Report: 앱이 멈춘 순간 앱과 기기가 무엇을 하고 있었는지 기록한 파일

Stack Trace - A list of the function calls that were active when an error happened, from newest to oldest.
한국어: Stack Trace: 오류가 났을 때 실행 중이던 함수 호출을 최신 것부터 차례로 나열한 목록

dSYM - A debug symbols file that turns raw addresses in a report back into function names.
한국어: dSYM: 리포트 속 원시 주소를 다시 함수 이름으로 바꿔 주는 디버그 심볼 파일

landscape.hook: Can you explain Crash Report, Stack Trace and dSYM in English?

dialogue.title: Why did it crash?
dialogue.setting: Users report a crash on launch

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, users say the app crashes on launch. Where do I start?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Open the crash report. A crash report records what the app was doing when it stopped.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: It has a lot of numbers. What should I read first?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Read the stack trace. A stack trace lists the function calls, from newest to oldest.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the top line is `parse`, and `load` is below it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. The crash is in `parse`, and `load` called it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: But some lines show only addresses, not names.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then you need the dSYM. A dSYM turns raw addresses back into function names.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Where do I find the dSYM file?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Xcode makes one for every archive, so upload the dSYM to the crash tool.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And then the crash report shows readable names?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, and the stack trace in the crash report tells you the exact function.
Open the crash report from yesterday.
